compass.title: Workview & Lifeview Compass
compass.desc: Calibrate your internal orientation by articulating your philosophy of work and life, resolving friction or synergies.
compass.workviewDesc: What is work to you? Money, purpose, service, or personal realization? What defines worthwhile work?
compass.workviewPlaceholder: Write deep reflections on your philosophy of work (250 words recommended)...
compass.lifeviewDesc: What gives life enduring meaning? What values are sacred and non-negotiable? Where do humans fit in the universe?
compass.lifeviewPlaceholder: Write reflections on your foundational life philosophy and non-negotiable values...
compass.depthRecommended: At least 250 words recommended for meaningful cognitive depth
compass.coherenceDesc: Where do your Workview and Lifeview complement each other, and where do they create tension or conflict?
compass.complementPlaceholder: Where does your work directly nourish and serve your overarching lifeview?
compass.conflictPlaceholder: Where do practical work realities collide with or compromise your core values?
compass.guidePlaceholder: How does this unified compass steer your decisions at major forks in the road?

vault.title: Secure Local Vault
vault.subtitle: Client-side AES-256-GCM and Argon2id encryption. Your personal reflections never leave your device.
vault.weakPassphrase: Passphrase must be at least 8 characters.

odysseyPlans.presenterEnergyPlaceholder: What energy, hesitation, or resonance did you notice while presenting?

onboarding.title: Welcome to Odyssey: Life Design Studio
onboarding.step1Desc: Life is not an engineering problem with a singular pre-calculated outcome; it is dynamic and inherently wicked. Life design is about building your way forward starting exactly where you are.
onboarding.step1MythDesc: You do not need to wait for a sudden revelation of passion before starting; meaningful passion and direction are the downstream byproduct of action, curiosity, and testing small prototypes in the real world.
onboarding.step2Title: The Five Mindsets of a Life Designer
onboarding.step2Desc: Five behavioral compass points for navigating ambiguity:
onboarding.step3Desc: Calibrated current-state assessment (HWPL), Work & Life Compass views, Good Time Journal with AEIOU, three parallel five-year Odyssey Plans, and prototyping inquiries.
onboarding.step4Desc: Your inaugural Cycle 1 workspace is ready. Ready to enter your drafting studio?

nudges.hwplCuriosityPrompt: Assess each of the four gauges without self-judgment, adopting the perspective of an inquisitive investigator.
nudges.journalCuriosityPrompt: Which activities generate renewed energy and which trivial tasks drain your reserves?
nudges.compassAwarenessPrompt: What is work to you? What core values anchor your life? Notice where they align and where tensions emerge.
nudges.odysseyBiasPrompt: Instead of debating plan perfection, formulate a question testable through a 20-minute conversation or rapid prototype.
